title: Exeter wobbling disc

tellings.quote: four people, two cops see a large disc from a 100 feet away and a 100 feet altitude engaging in a wobbling motion.

plain: In 1964 in Exeter, New Hampshire, four people, two of them police officers, are said to have seen a large disc about 100 feet away and about 100 feet up, wobbling as it moved. Marik von Rennenkampff, a guest on the show, gives this as a short summary without naming his source, in an episode where Michels challenges the skeptic Mick West to a debate. He offers it as a case with several credible witnesses, police among them, seeing a craft up close.
